BlueprintIdentity.description:
Identifies a blueprint document by application, name and content hash.

This is identity, not location: compare `DeferredBlueprintRef`, which
locates the blueprint file an upstream step will write.

kind.description: The kind of document referenced; selects the model a reference loads as.
kind.title: Kind

application.description: The application the referenced blueprint belongs to.
application.title: Application

name.description: The name of the referenced blueprint.
name.title: Name

content_hash.description: A fingerprint of the referenced blueprint's configuration.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

BlueprintIdentity.title: BlueprintIdentity

BlueprintState.description: The allowed states for a work plan.
BlueprintState.title: BlueprintState

CatalogSpecRef.description: A reference to a catalog spec a document was derived from.

name.description: The name of the referenced spec.
name.title: Name

origin.description: Where the spec came from, e.g. `catalog`, `custom` or `model_default`; empty when unknown.
origin.title: Origin

modified.description: Whether the spec was edited after it was selected.
modified.title: Modified

CatalogSpecRef.title: CatalogSpecRef

ChunkSettings.description: A chunk-shape override along x, y and z; an unset axis is derived.
ChunkSettings.title: ChunkSettings

FileTypeMatch.description:
A portable description of a file type: it ignores dimension sizes, so it
matches the same output of another domain.

filename.description: A glob for the file's path relative to its step root, e.g. `output/output_cdr.*.nc`.
filename.title: Filename

requires_variables.description:
Variables every file of the type holds. When a filename template splits
into several types, the variables that tell them apart come first, so the
most specific match wins (`settings_for`).
requires_variables.title: Requires Variables

FileTypeMatch.title: FileTypeMatch

FileTypeSettings.description: How to compress one type of data file.

name.description: A label for the type, e.g. `output_cdr`.
name.title: Name

application.description: The application of the steps whose files are this type.
application.title: Application

compress.description: Rewrite the files as chunked, deflated netCDF-4 (lossless on its own).
compress.title: Compress

float32.description: Cast float64 variables that are not protected to float32.
float32.title: Float32

significant_digits.description:
With `float32`, also quantize those variables (BitGroom) to this many
significant decimal digits.
significant_digits.title: Significant Digits

chunks.description: Chunk-shape overrides; unset axes are derived from each variable.

protected.description:
Variables (names or globs) kept exact; filled from the application's
`protected_variables` and editable.
protected.title: Protected

FileTypeSettings.title: FileTypeSettings

GeneratedBy.description: The event that produced a document.

tool.description:
The producer: an application such as `forge`, or another C-Star tool such
as `wizard`. Not validated against the application registry, as not every
producer is an application.
tool.title: Tool

id.description:
Identifies this event, so a copied or edited document still says where it
came from. A uuid4 minted when the model is created and never recomputed: a
value loaded from a file is kept.
id.title: Id

system.description: The C-Star system the producer ran on; empty if unknown.
system.title: System

versions.description: The versions of the packages involved, keyed by package name.
versions.title: Versions

run_id.description: The workplan run id, when a workplan step produced the document.
run_id.title: Run Id

working_dir.description:
Where the producer wrote its artifacts; informational, as artifacts can
move.
working_dir.title: Working Dir

GeneratedBy.title: GeneratedBy

Provenance.description:
Records what produced a document and what it was derived from.

Applications may subclass it to add application-specific fields.

generated_by.description: The event that produced the document.

derived_from.description: The blueprints and catalog specs the document was derived from.
derived_from.title: Derived From

Provenance.title: Provenance

description: A blueprint compressing the data files of a finished run in place.

$schema.description: The URL of the published JSON schema the blueprint follows.
$schema.title: $schema

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for this blueprint.
name.title: Name

description.description: A user-friendly description of the scenario to be executed by the blueprint.
description.title: Description

state.description: The current validation status of the blueprint.

schema_version.description: The current schema version for this blueprint.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

working_dir.description: Directory the application writes to; omitted, C-Star uses ``CSTAR_DATA_HOME/blueprint_runs/<application>/<name>``.
working_dir.title: Working Dir

provenance.description: What produced this blueprint and what it was derived from; empty when not recorded.

run.description: The root directory of the run to compress.
run.title: Run

file_types.description:
The settings of each file type; a file takes the most specific match
(`settings_for`), and a file matching none is left as it is.
file_types.title: File Types

originals.description:
What happens to an original once its compressed copy is verified: deleted,
or moved to `<run>/uncompressed_originals/`.
originals.title: Originals

workers.description: Files compressed at once, each in its own process.
workers.title: Workers

title: CompressBlueprint
